complete_examples.text: In general, one also assumes that the parameters of the filling layer obey lognormal distribution that is similar to Eq. (19), and its spatial correlation is expressed by the exponential kernel [36].

In Ref. [39], the spatial variability of concrete properties was carried out by the experiment test, the statistical result showed that the elastic modulus of concrete might satisfy the lognormal distribution function.
The PDF of k휐 can be described as the normal distribution, lognormal distribution, extremal distribution, etc.
